name: Ellie Mental Health
one_liner: A national franchise of local outpatient clinics offering in-person and virtual therapy and medication management, mostly through insurance.
best_for: People who want in-person therapy at a local clinic and to use insurance
Families looking for child, teen, couples or family therapy
People who want therapy and medication management in one practice
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988 (Ellie does not provide emergency services)
People who need intensive programs such as IOP, PHP or residential care
People with no Ellie clinic nearby who want in-person care
short_description: Outpatient therapy clinics (260+ locations) for individuals, couples and families, with psychiatric medication management at some sites; in person or virtual.
long_description: Ellie Mental Health is a Minnesota-founded network of outpatient mental health clinics, most of them independently owned franchises. Clinics offer individual, couples and family therapy for children, teens and adults, and some offer psychiatric medication management and community-based services, either in person or by video. The company says it has more than 260 locations nationwide. Because each clinic is independently owned, services, accepted insurance plans and self-pay prices vary by location; clinics take many commercial plans and, at some sites, Medicare and other public plans. Ellie does not provide emergency services. You find a nearby clinic with the 'Find My Ellie' locator or by calling 1-888-MY-ELLIE.

pricing.starting_price: Copay with insurance; self-pay rates set by each clinic
pricing.notes: Clinics are independently owned; accepted insurance and self-pay prices vary by location. Example: the Estero, FL clinic says it accepts over 300 insurance plans. No national self-pay price is published.

privacy.notes: Policy (read 2026-10-27) says Ellie will not sell or rent personal information, but uses cookies and pixels and may use personal and device information for marketing and retargeting; no deletion right stated.

faqs.q: What is Ellie Mental Health and who is it for?
faqs.a: Ellie Mental Health is a digital health platform designed to support mental health and wellness.

faqs.q: How much does Ellie Mental Health cost?
faqs.a: Ellie Mental Health pricing varies. Contact them for current pricing.

faqs.q: Is Ellie Mental Health covered by insurance?
faqs.a: Coverage varies by plan. Check with your insurance provider or the platform directly.

primary_uses: Individual therapy for anxiety and depression

patient_summary: You see a therapist at a local Ellie clinic, in person or by video, for weekly or regular sessions; some clinics also offer medication management. You find a clinic near you on Ellie's website or by calling 1-888-MY-ELLIE, and most people pay their insurance copay. Self-pay rates are set by each clinic.

availability.note: 260+ mostly franchised clinics across the US, in person and virtual; services and insurance vary by clinic. Use the Find My Ellie locator to see what is near you.
